exposure: Prior recording-weighted GAVD and external outcomes already known; this is post hoc, not preregistered.
question: Does the posture-versus-persistence forecast result persist when each normal gait sequence receives equal weight?
population: Same frozen141normal sequences in29original recording components; no eligibility changes.
estimator: Average fixed window MSE within each sequence; equally weight sequence errors.
comparison: ridge_posture versus persistence only; original eight-query horizon and target support.
resampling: Sample whole normal recording components with replacement within each original outer fold; retain all their sequences and multiplicities; divide each draw by its total selected sequence count.
direction: Persistence error minus posture error; positive favors posture.
method_changes: No fitting, score recalibration, anomalous-label selection or change to frozen primary endpoints.
